description: This file defines the TinyMCE popup handling class, including methods for window management, resizing, selection restoration, and callback execution within the TinyMCE rich text editor plugin.

classes.name: TinyMCE_Popup
classes.description: Class managing popup window behavior for TinyMCE editor, including initialization, resizing, selection management, and callback handling.

methods.name: findWin
methods.description: Finds the window object containing the tinyMCE instance by checking parent, opener, or top window.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the popup, sets references, configures language and styles, and sets up event handlers.

methods.name: onLoad
methods.description: Handles actions to perform when the popup loads, such as variable replacement and layout adjustments.

methods.name: executeOnLoad
methods.description: Executes a string of code on load, with special handling for Opera browser.

methods.name: resizeToInnerSize
methods.description: Resizes the popup window to fit its inner content, with special handling for different browsers.

methods.name: resizeToContent
methods.description: Resizes the window to fit its content, with browser-specific logic.

methods.name: getWindowArg
methods.description: Retrieves window arguments passed to the popup.

methods.name: restoreSelection
methods.description: Restores text selection in the editor if stored.

methods.name: execCommand
methods.description: Executes a command in the TinyMCE editor, restoring selection beforehand.

methods.name: openBrowser
methods.description: Opens a file browser dialog via callback.

methods.name: importClass
methods.description: Imports a class from the opener window into the current window.
